vectors.description: 1 leaf: the root binds a single leaf.
vectors.name: leaves-1

vectors.description: 3 leafs: an odd count; the last node at each odd level is promoted, never duplicated.
vectors.name: leaves-3

vectors.description: 5 leafs: an odd count; the last node at each odd level is promoted, never duplicated.
vectors.name: leaves-5

vectors.description: 7 leafs: an odd count; the last node at each odd level is promoted, never duplicated.
vectors.name: leaves-7

vectors.description: Non-ASCII text is kept exactly as written: accents, CJK, a currency sign, a non-BMP character and quotation marks.
vectors.name: unicode

vectors.description: Exact integer minor units at 14 digits, the longest the repository's guards allow without an approved exception; arithmetic is BigInt throughout.
vectors.name: large-amounts

vectors.description: An internal transfer (two equal and opposite legs, netting to zero) and a boundary transfer out of scope.
vectors.name: transfers

vectors.description: A period with no cash activity is still a non-empty tree: one reconciliation event says so (MR-33).
vectors.name: zero-cash

vectors.description: A disbursement, its exact reversal and a replacement, each linked to the original (MR-21).
vectors.name: correction

vectors.description: Optional fields left out or empty: no correction, no redaction reason, no restriction, no references.
vectors.name: empty-optional

vectors.description: USD and EUR events are totalled separately; there is no cross-currency total.
vectors.name: multi-currency
